# Range slider (`range-slider`)

Two-thumb range.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createRangeSlider` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/rangeSlider.d.ts`): `.mh-range-slider`: two thumbs choosing a range (a comfort band, a time window, a price filter). Each thumb is anative `<input type="range">` laid over one shared track, so arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home/End and screen readerswork per thumb; the thumbs never cross (`minGap` keeps them apart). Pressing the track moves the nearer thumb anddrags it. The fill is drawn from `--_lo` and `--_hi`.

```ts
export function createRangeSlider(options: RangeSliderOptions): RangeSliderHandle;

export interface RangeSliderOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  step?: number;
  /** `[low, high]`. Default the whole range. */
  value?: RangeValue;
  /** The smallest distance kept between the thumbs. Default 0. */
  minGap?: number;
  /** Shows "low – high" beside the label. */
  showValue?: boolean;
  /** Formats the shown values and each thumb's spoken `aria-valuetext`. */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
  marks?: readonly SliderMark[];
  /** Form names of the two inputs. */
  names?: readonly [string, string];
  labels?: Partial<RangeSliderLabels>;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** While dragging. */
  onInput?: (value: [number, number], event: Event) => void;
  /** When a thumb is let go or moved by key. */
  onChange?: (value: [number, number], event: Event) => void;
}

export interface RangeSliderHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  inputs: [HTMLInputElement, HTMLInputElement];
  getValue(): [number, number];
  setValue(value: RangeValue): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

/** The spoken names of the two thumbs, for translation. */
export interface RangeSliderLabels {
  low: string;
  high: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createRangeSlider } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const comfort = createRangeSlider({
  label: 'Comfort range',
  min: 14,
  max: 28,
  step: 0.5,
  minGap: 1,
  value: [19, 23],
  showValue: true,
  format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}°`,
  labels: { low: 'Heat below', high: 'Cool above' },
  onChange: ([low, high]) => (status.textContent = `Heating below ${low}°, cooling above ${high}°`),
});

document.body.append(comfort.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { RangeSlider } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function RangeSliderExample() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<[number, number]>([19, 23]);
  return (
    <RangeSlider
      label="Comfort range"
      min={14}
      max={28}
      step={0.5}
      minGap={1}
      showValue
      format={(v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}°`}
      labels={{ low: 'Heat below', high: 'Cool above' }}
      value={range}
      onValueChange={setRange}
    />
  );
}
```
